verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform, so privacy controls such as opting out of telemetry or usage tracking are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage analytics, or any opt-out control. The docs cover only banking APIs (accounts, KYC, ACH, wires, cards, webhooks) and sandbox testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
